+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat import unittest
+from units.compat.mock import Mock, patch
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux import LinuxNetwork, LinuxNetworkCollector
+
+
+class TestLocallyReachableIps(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        ipv6_patch = patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', True)
+        ipv6_patch.start()
+        self.addCleanup(ipv6_patch.stop)
+
+    def test_local_routes_are_normalized_sorted_and_deduplicated(self):
+        module = Mock()
+        module.run_command.side_effect = [
+            (0, 'local 192.168.1.42/24 dev lo scope host\n'
+                'local 127.0.0.1 dev lo scope host\n'
+                'broadcast 192.168.1.255 dev eth0 scope host\n'
+                'local 192.168.1.0/24 dev lo scope host\n'
+                'local 192.168.0.1/32 dev lo scope host\n', ''),
+            (0, 'local 2001:db8::2/64 dev lo scope host\n'
+                'local ::1/128 dev lo scope host\n'
+                'local 2001:db8::/64 dev lo scope host\n', ''),
+        ]
+
+        result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+
+        self.assertEqual(result['ipv4'], ['127.0.0.1', '192.168.0.1', '192.168.1.0/24'])
+        self.assertEqual(result['ipv6'], ['::1', '2001:db8::/64'])
+        self.assertEqual(module.run_command.call_args_list[0][0][0],
+                         ['/sbin/ip', '-4', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'local', 'scope', 'host'])
+        module.warn.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_failed_query_returns_empty_family_and_warns(self):
+        module = Mock()
+        module.run_command.side_effect = [(1, '', 'unsupported'), (0, 'local ::1 dev lo\n', '')]
+
+        result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+
+        self.assertEqual(result, {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': ['::1']})
+        module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Unable to gather locally reachable ipv4 IPs')
+
+    def test_ipv6_unavailable_returns_empty_list(self):
+        module = Mock()
+        module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'local 127.0.0.0/8 dev lo\n', '')
+
+        with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', False):
+            result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+
+        self.assertEqual(result, {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8'], 'ipv6': []})
+        self.assertEqual(module.run_command.call_count, 1)
+        module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Unable to gather locally reachable ipv6 IPs: IPv6 is unavailable')
+
+    def test_populate_exposes_fact_when_ip_is_missing(self):
+        module = Mock()
+        module.get_bin_path.return_value = None
+
+        result = LinuxNetwork(module).populate()
+
+        self.assertEqual(result['locally_reachable_ips'], {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': []})
+        self.assertIn('locally_reachable_ips', LinuxNetworkCollector._fact_ids)
+        module.warn.assert_called_once()
+
+    def test_populate_adds_local_routes_to_network_facts(self):
+        module = Mock()
+        module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/ip'
+        module.run_command.side_effect = [
+            (0, 'local 127.0.0.0/8 dev lo\n', ''),
+            (0, 'local ::1 dev lo\n', ''),
+        ]
+        network = LinuxNetwork(module)
+        network.get_default_interfaces = Mock(return_value=({}, {}))
+        network.get_interfaces_info = Mock(return_value=({}, {'all_ipv4_addresses': [], 'all_ipv6_addresses': []}))
+
+        facts = network.populate()
+
+        self.assertEqual(facts['locally_reachable_ips'], {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8'], 'ipv6': ['::1']})
+        self.assertEqual(facts['all_ipv4_addresses'], [])
